source.prompt: Deep house song, about 3.5 minutes, 118 BPM, F minor. After-hours harbour mood, smoky, warm and intimate. Soft, breathy female lead vocal with gentle stacked harmonies on the chorus. Warm Rhodes electric piano chords, smooth finger bass, soft clean electric guitar swells, lush string pad. Soft four-on-the-floor kick, gentle offbeat open hats, soft claps on 2 and 4, light shaker. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, smooth, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Mm, mm

[Verse]
Streetlights hum a quiet tune
Half past two and half a moon
You and I on the harbour wall
Waiting for the dark to fall

Fold me in, fold me in

[Chorus]
